verses.text: Ha t'a jun sk'ual ik'oj ip, ix ek' Jesús t'a jun b'e t'a skal ixim trigo yet' heb' sk'ayb'um. Haxo heb' sk'ayb'um chi', ix te och swejel heb'. Yuj chi', ix sk'utzelta ixim jolom trigo chi' heb', ix swuchanel ixim heb' sk'uxu'.

Palta ix yilan juntzanh heb' winh fariseo tas ix sk'ulej heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb' t'a Jesús: --Ina heb' a k'ayb'um tik. Wan smunlaj heb' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, palta manh sleyalok sko k'ulej icha chi', xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom manta b'aj tzeyil t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, tas sk'ulejnak winhaj David t'a junel, ayik ste ochnak swejel winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok?

Xit'nakek' winh t'a skajnub' Dios. Swanak juntzanh ixim pan winh yiknhej Dios yaji yet' heb' ajun yet'ok chi'. Ha juntzanh ixim pan chi', anhej heb' sakerdote ay yalan yik swaan ixim. Manh sleyalok skomon waan ixim winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Palta manh mulok jun sk'ulejnak winh chi' yet' heb' t'a yichanh Dios.
¿Tom malaj b'aj ix eyil t'a ley Moisés to a heb' sakerdote, heb' ay t'a yol stemplo Dios, manh sk'anab'ajejnakok sk'ual ik'oj ip heb'? Palta manh ochnakoklaj smulok heb'.
Palta a in tik swal t'ayex, ay jun t'a he kal tik ek'to yelk'och t'a yichanh stemplo Dios, a in ton tik.

Oktom wal snachajel eyuuj tas yalnakkan Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, ayik yalannakkan icha tik: In gana tz'ok' he k'ool t'a heb' eyetanimail. Manhoknhej juntzanh silab' snhusji chi' in gana, xchi. Oktom snachajel jun tik eyuuj, max am eyala' to tz'och smul heb' malaj smul.
Ha in tik Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail, yuj chi' syal walani tas sko k'ulej t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi Jesús t'a heb' winh fariseo chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at Jesús, ix k'och t'a yol spatil skulto heb' winh.

Hata' ay jun winh sikb'inakel sk'ab', junelnhej takinh rokinak. Haxo heb' winh chi', snib'ej heb' winh ay junok smul Jesús tz'ilchaji, yik syak'och heb' winh t'a yib'anh. Yuj chi', ix stz'akan sk'anb'ej heb' winh t'ay: --¿Ay am sleyal skak' b'oxok junok penaay t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, mato maay? xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Q'uinalok ay junok nok' he kalnel sb'at t'a yol junok xab' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ¿tom max ex b'at eyik'k'eta nok'?
Okxom junok anima, yelxo wal niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh junok nok' kalnel chi'. Yuj chi', sleyal ton sko k'ulej juntzanh tas wach' t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, xchi t'a heb' winh.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix yalan t'a winh: --Hak'uel lian a k'ab' chi', xchi t'a winh. Ix slianel sk'ab' winh chi', ix b'oxikan b'ian. Lajan ix aj yet' jun toxonton wach' chi'.
Haxo ix elta heb' winh fariseo chi', ix slajtian sb'a heb' winh tas ol yutok heb' winh smilan Jesús.
Ayik ix snaanel Jesús tas snib'ej heb' syutej, ix sb'esanel sb'a ta'. Tzijtum anima ix b'at yet'ok. Masanil heb' penaay, ix laj b'oxikan sk'ool heb' yuj.
Ix yalan t'a heb': --Ayta b'aj tzeyaleli mach in, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías, winh schekab' Dios t'a peka'. Xchikan icha tik:

Ha jun tik, in chekab' yaji, sik'b'il yajkanel wuuj. Te xajan wuuj. Tzin k'e wal chaanh yet'ok. Ol wak' Wespíritu t'ay. Ol yalanel t'a skal heb' manh israelok to ol ch'olb'itaj tas yaj heb' t'a stojolal.
Malaj b'aj ol yak' owal. Malaj b'aj ol el yaw. Malaj mach ol ab'an sjaj t'a yol kalle.

Ay heb' ob'iltak, icha junok te' aj spakchaji, ma icha junok kandil wan stupi, icha chi' yaj heb', palta ha' ol kolwaj yet' heb', manh ol ixtaj heb' yuj. Icha chi' ol yutok sb'a, masanto ol wach' och yajalil, haxo yak'an yajalil chi' t'a stojolal.
Haxo heb' anima t'a junjun chonhab', ol yak'och heb' yipok sk'ool, xchi Dios t'a Slolonel Tz'ib'ab'ilkani.

Ay jun winh ix ik'jib'at t'a Jesús. Max ujilaj yilan winh, max yalpaxlaj slolon winh, yujto ixtab'il winh yuj jun enemigo. Haxo Jesús ix ak'an b'oxok sk'ool winh. Yuj chi' ix yilxi winh, ix lolonxi winh.
Haxo heb' anima smasanil ix te sat sk'ool heb' yilani. Ix laj yalan heb': --Ha jun winh tik, ¿tekan a jun yinhtilal winhaj David winh tanhwab'il sja kuuj? xchi heb'.

Palta ayik ix yab'an juntzanh chi' heb' winh fariseo, ix yalan heb' winh: --Ha jun winh tik, syalton yik'anel heb' enemigo winh, yujto a winh Beelzebú, yajal heb' enemigo, a ayoch yet' winh, xchi heb' winh.

Haxo Jesús, yojtakxo tas wan snaan heb' winh chi', yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha junok nakión spoj sb'a t'a yol yiko', sjuwieli. Hanhejtona' junok chonhab', ma junok pat spoj sb'a t'a yol yiko', sjuwipaxeli.
Hanhejtona', icha pax chi' winh Satanás, tato spechel heb' yetenemigoal winh, spojnakxom sb'a heb', ¿tom ol najtilax yopisio winh?

Ha ex tik tzeyala', yujto ayoch winh Beelzebú wet'ok yuj chi' tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi'. Tato yel tzeyala', ¿mach ayoch yet' heb' he k'ayb'um chi' ayik spechanel heb' enemigo chi' heb'? Hanhejtona' heb' he k'ayb'um chi' sch'oxanel he paltail.
Palta yujnhej Yespíritu Dios tzin pechel heb' enemigo chi'. Yuj chi', scheklajeli to toxo ix och Dios yak' yajalil t'a he kal.

Q'uinalok ay junok winh te ay yip. Malaj junok mach syal skomon och t'a yol spat winh, syik'anb'at tastak ay t'a winh. Anhej tato tz'ak'ji ganar stzek'chajkan winh aj pat chi', anhej icha chi', syal yik'jib'at tastak ay t'a yol spat winh chi'.
Ha heb' manh ayokoch wet'ok, ajk'ool heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' max molb'ankot heb' anima t'ayin, a heb' spechan saklem heb' anima chi'.

Yuj chi', swal t'ayex, yalxonhej tas smul heb' anima, yalxonhej tas malaj swach'il syal heb', ol yal yak'ji lajwok yuj Dios. Palta a heb' sb'uchwaj t'a Yespíritu Dios, manhxo ol ak'joklaj niwank'olal heb'.

Ha heb' tz'alan junok chukal t'a in patik a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik, syal yak'ji lajwok smul heb'. Palta haxo heb' sb'uchwaj t'a spatik Yespíritu Dios, a smul heb' chi', manhxo ol ek'b'atlaj, wach'chom tiknaik, wach'chom t'a junxo tiempoal toto ol jawok.
Naek sik'lab'il, tato ay junok te te' wach', wach' sat te' syak'a'. Tato ay junok te te' chuk, chuk sat te' syak'a'. Yuj sat te' chi', skojtakejel tas te'al te'.
Ha ex tik, lajan ex icha juntzanh nok' chan. Malaj he wach'il. Yuj chi', ¿tom ay jab'ok tas wach' syal eyalani? Yujto anhej tas ay t'a he pensar, anhej chi' tzeyala'.
Tato wach' ko pensar, wach' skutej ko b'a, yujto anhej tas wach' chi' ay t'a ko pensar. Haxo ta chuk ko pensar, chuk skutej ko b'a, yujto anhej chukal sko na'a.
Yuj chi', swal t'ayex, hato yik ol ja jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, jantaknhej juntzanh lolonel malaj yopisio tzeyala', ol ch'olb'itaj tas heyaj yuj.
Yujto ha Dios ol ex ch'olb'itan yuj tas tzeyala'. Ol yala', tato malaj he mul yuj tas slaj eyal chi', mato ay, xchi Jesús.
Ay juntzanh heb' winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés yet' juntzanh heb' winh fariseo ix halan t'a Jesús: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ko gana tza ch'ox junok milagro kila', xchi heb' winh t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a heb' winh: --Ha ex t'a jun pekti' tik, malaj he wach'il, manhok t'a Dios tzeyak'och he pensar. Tonhej tze k'an eyil junok milagro, junok sch'oxan spoder Dios. Palta a junok milagro ol ch'oxjok heyila', haton jun icha sch'oxnak Dios yet' jun winh schekab' skuchan Jonás.

Ha winhaj Jonás chi', oxe' k'ual, oxe' ak'wal ek'nak winh t'a yol sk'ool jun nok' niwan chay. Icha ajnak winhaj Jonás chi', icha chi' ol in aj pax a in tik, a in Ak'b'il in kot yuj Dios woch animail tik. Oxe' k'ual, oxe' ak'wal ol in ek' t'a yol lu'um.

Ayik ek' yalannakkanel yab'ixal Dios winhaj Jonás t'a heb' aj Nínive, snanak wal sb'a heb'. Haxo tiknaik, ayinek' heyet'ok, ek'to welk'och t'a yichanh winhaj Jonás chi', palta max he nalaj he b'a. Yuj chi', hato ol jawok jun k'ual yik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, a heb' aj Nínive chi', ol k'e waan heb', ol yalan he mul heb'.

Icha pax chi' jun ix yajal t'a Sur t'a peka', te najat kotnak ix, ul yab'annak sjelanil winhaj Salomón ix. Haxo tiknaik, ay in ek' t'a tik, ek'to welk'och t'a yichanh winh, palta max ul he k'anb'ej eyab' t'ayin. Yuj chi', hato ol jawok jun k'ual ayik ol ch'olb'itaj tas eyaji, ol k'e waan ix, ol yalan he mul ix.
Q'uinalok ay jun enemigo tz'el t'a junok anima tiknaik. Tz'ek' t'a tzinan lu'um, sayan b'aj syik' yip. Palta max ilchaj yuj.
Yuj chi' snaani: Ol in pax t'a in pat b'aj kotnak in, xchi. Haxo yik sk'ochxi, syilan jun anima chi', icha junok pat mesesi yool, malaj yajal, wach' yilji.

Yuj chi' smeltzajxib'at t'a spatik, sb'at yik'ankot ukwanhokxo heb' enemigo ek'to schukal t'a yichanh. Swach' och kajan heb' smasanil t'a jun anima chi'. Yuj chi', ste juwiel jun anima chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal. Icha jun anima chi', icha chi' ol aj swach' juwiel he pensar a ex tik, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Wanto yalan Jesús t'a heb' anima chi', ix k'och ix snun yet' heb' yuk'tak. Ha t'a ti' pat ix k'och heb'. Snib'ej heb' sk'umej Jesús chi'.
Yuj chi' ay jun winh ix halan t'a Jesús: --Ix ja ix a nun yet' heb' uk'tak t'a ti' pat. Snib'ej heb' slolon het'ok, xchi winh t'ay.
Palta ix yalan Jesús t'a winh: --¿Mach ix in nun, mach heb' wuk'tak chi' tza na'a? xchi.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sch'oxan heb' sk'ayb'um t'a winh. --Haton heb' tik, icha in nun, icha wuk'tak yaj heb'.
Yujto a mach sk'ulan tas snib'ej in Mam t'a satcha'anh, haton heb' chi' icha wuk'tak, icha wanab', icha in nun yaji, xchi Jesús.
